post_text:
New Year's Eve in a Paris palace this year costs from €280 to €1,095 per person, before wine.

– @Le Meurice, under General Manager @Pascal Billard: €1,095 at Le Meurice Alain Ducasse, where chef @Amaury Bouhours leads the kitchen, or €1,650 with wine
– @Hôtel Plaza Athénée: €1,050 at La Grande Table, now led by executive chef @Jocelyn Herland; €580 for the dinner dance in the Salon Haute Couture, with a live band then a DJ
– @Hôtel de Crillon, A Rosewood Hotel: €365 for dinner at Nonos by @Paul Pairet; €350 for the party at Les Ambassadeurs until 4am, champagne included
– @Mandarin Oriental Lutetia, under General Manager @Julien Bardet: €280 for a six-course dinner at Brasserie Lutetia, with a vegan menu at the same price

Le Meurice and the Plaza Athénée are both @Dorchester Collection hotels, led since June 2025 by CEO @Philippe Leboeuf.

The Ritz Paris, Cheval Blanc Paris and Le Royal Monceau have not yet published their 2026 offers.

The signal: Paris palaces now sell New Year's Eve as several products at very different prices, from the brasserie to the gastronomic table and the late-night bar.

Where would you spend the night?
